description: Manage evroc Think Models (dedicated GPU instances, shared models, API keys, coding agent integration). Trigger on AI/model/inference/GPU keywords on evroc. Block on compute/IAM/storage/network.

cases.query: Deploy a dedicated Mistral model on evroc with H100
List the evroc shared models I can use
Create an API key for evroc Think
Launch Claude Code with evroc Think as the model backend
Create an S3 bucket on evroc
Create a dedicated instance with 1 B200 GPU
expected_behavior: Lists available sizes with evroc think size list
Selects a size matching GPU type (B200) and count (1)
Does NOT guess a size name

cases.query: Create an instance with the latest Mistral model
expected_behavior: Lists models with evroc think model list (or model get for specific name)
Uses exact HuggingFace handle from the output
Does NOT invent or abbreviate model IDs

cases.query: I want to run inference on evroc
expected_behavior: Explains the difference between Shared Models (zero deploy, ready now) and Dedicated Instances (isolated GPU, takes time)
Recommends Shared Models for quick trials and Dedicated for isolation/customization
Suggests evroc think sharedmodel list or evroc think instance create accordingly
